title: Intro to C#
line: Console apps with lists, classes and LINQ, built with dotnet.

project.title: A habit tracker
project.brief: Make a console app on your own. A Habit class with a name and a list of days done, a dictionary of habits, and a report of each habit by percent done, highest first.
checks: dotnet run builds and exits with no error
Each habit prints its name and the percent of days done
The habits print ordered by percent, highest first

lessons.title: Create and run a console app
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner to create a C# console app with dotnet new console, edit Program.cs in VS Code to print a three-line haiku and run it with dotnet run.
lessons.passes: dotnet run builds the app and prints three lines.

lessons.title: Variables and types
lessons.goal: Teach C# int, double, decimal, bool, string and var by building a currency converter that turns an amount in dollars into euros at a fixed rate.
lessons.passes: 100 dollars at a rate of 0.92 prints 92.00 euros.

lessons.title: Strings and interpolation
lessons.goal: Teach C# string interpolation with format and alignment, plus Length and ToUpper, by printing a shop receipt with three items in neat columns.
lessons.passes: The receipt prints three aligned rows with prices to two decimals.

lessons.title: If, else and switch
lessons.goal: Teach C# if, else and the switch expression by writing a season finder that turns a month number into winter, spring, summer or autumn.
lessons.passes: Months 1, 4, 7 and 10 print winter, spring, summer and autumn.

lessons.title: For, while and foreach
lessons.goal: Teach C# for, while and foreach loops by printing the first 15 Fibonacci numbers, starting from 0 and 1, and then their sum.
lessons.passes: The last number printed is 377 and the sum is 986.

lessons.title: Methods
lessons.goal: Teach C# methods with parameters, return values and optional parameters by building a BMI calculator with one method for the number and one for the label.
lessons.passes: 70 kg at 1.75 m prints a BMI of 22.9 and the label for a healthy weight.

lessons.title: Lists
lessons.goal: Teach the C# List with Add, Remove, Contains, Count, Sort and foreach by building a team lineup that signs players and drops one.
lessons.passes: The lineup prints in alphabetical order with the dropped player gone.

lessons.title: Dictionaries
lessons.goal: Teach the C# Dictionary with add, lookup, TryGetValue and foreach by building a Morse code translator for letters and digits.
lessons.passes: SOS prints as three dots, three dashes and three dots.

lessons.title: Classes and properties
lessons.goal: Teach C# classes with properties, a constructor and methods by building a Thermostat class whose target stays between 10 and 30 degrees.
lessons.passes: Setting the target to 45 leaves it at 30, and to 2 leaves it at 10.

lessons.title: LINQ
lessons.goal: Teach C# LINQ with Where, OrderBy, Select and Average by reporting on marathon results, the runners under four hours sorted by finish time.
lessons.passes: Only runners under four hours print, fastest first, with the average time.
